name: Calibrate a mastery check
prompt: Learner: /test mastery my understanding of supply and demand. I want to know whether I can use it in unfamiliar situations, not just repeat definitions.

judge.check: The tutor identifies mastery mode and plans a progression from direct application toward unfamiliar transfer.
The first response contains exactly one test question and does not reveal answers to later questions.
Difficulty is meaningful through changed familiarity, reasoning, scaffolding, representation, or transfer distance rather than labels alone.
